messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — we need a minimal hotpatch for the runtime auth header bug. Proposing bump from v1.11.1 -> v1.11.2, branch off release/1.11 and cut at 12:00 PT today. Keep diffs tiny.

sam: Ack. Is this regressing any APIs or just internal header parsing?

anya: Just internal header parsing for legacy clients. No public API changes.

mike: I can take the changelog + version bump. Will open a tiny PR against release/1.11.

lina: I have a one-line fix ready for the parser, light unit test. Pushing in ~10m.

chris: Heads-up: CI concurrency is a bit slow atm, might add 15-20m to the cut. If we need under 12:00 we should cap e2e.

anya: Good call. Let's do: unit tests + sanity smoke only for the hotpatch. No full e2e.

mike: Drafting PR now. Version change in package.json:
```json
{"version": "1.11.2"}
```
I'll include changelog stub: "hotfix: fix auth header parsing for legacy clients (minimal)"

lina: Pushed branch fix/auth-header-hotpatch -> will open PR against release/1.11 shortly.

sam: @lina can you also add a short regression prompt to the evals suite? Just one case to prevent reintro.

lina: Yep. Adding a single-case eval now.

deploy-bot: Release branch created: release/1.11-1755004321 at commit abc1234 (by lina) :robot_face:

chris: I ran a quick perf smoke. No latency regressions in basic paths. :+1:

anya: If PRs are green by 11:30 PT we'll cut and tag. Anyone blocking?

sam: I'm reviewing mike's changelog PR — small nits. Will approve once fixed.

mike: Fixed nit, pushed.

sam: Approved.

lina: PR for code + eval is green.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: unit -> smoke -> tag ready (jobs passed)

anya: OK cutting at 11:40 PT to give ops a 20m buffer. Will create the tag and trigger the minimal deploy.

chris: Ops, please standby for the canary window.

ops: standby acknowledged. ready for canary trigger.

anya: Tagging and deploying now. Tag: v1.11.2-hotfix-auth.

deploy-bot: Tag created v1.11.2-hotfix-auth at commit abc1234. Canary deploy started (2 nodes).

chris: Canary looks clean after 5m. No errors in auth traces. :eyes:

anya: Rolling to remaining nodes.

deploy-bot: Rolling deployment complete. All nodes updated to v1.11.2-hotfix-auth.

mike: Updated changelog entry in CHANGES.md and linked the PR in release notes.

sam: Thanks everyone. Quick retrospective: keep e2e out of hotpatch path unless required. Make small eval cases part of hotpatch checklist.

anya: Agreed. I'll update the release checklist template. Closing this thread once I add checklist note. :white_check_mark:

chris: Nice and surgical. Great job.

anya: Closing in 10m unless anyone needs follow-up.
